newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK weather - cloudy with sunny periods, max 22 C.
newsitem.headline: HK weather - cloudy with sunny periods, max 22 C.

text.p: It will be cloudy in the morning with sunny periods during the day, the Royal Observatory said on Monday.
The maximum temperature will be about 22 C with moderate easterly winds, fresh offshore and on high ground at first.
At 7 a.m. the temperature was 19 C and the relative humidity 74 percent.
Outlook: appreciably cooler by midweek. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6441
